verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own escalation paths, which route alerts to schedules and team members. It also supports priority and working-hours rules on those paths, and alerts can create escalations. However, none of the evidence describes the multi-step mechanics this story asks for. Missing for 10: documented multi-level steps with timeout delays, fallback responders, repeat rounds, stopping on acknowledgement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
